reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
A truly hammy military action stinker. I made a concerted "effort" to try and watch this, but I found it was so awful I gave up. A dull propagandised "Russia is the devil" back story, crummy, cliched characterisations and narrative to match. Action is all over the place and lacks any sense of continuity, within the context of the "story", such as it is.

Acting is okay at times, but it's a lit match in a windowless cellar.

In summary, watching "Man of War" made my brain hurt. Enough said.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When an American aid worker disappears during the outbreak of war in Ukraine, a hardened former Navy SEAL and CIA operative embarks on a dangerous rescue mission across active combat zones.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: As full-scale conflict erupts across Ukraine, an aid worker goes missing amidst the chaos, leaving behind few clues to her location. Driven by duty and personal history, a former Navy SEAL and veteran CIA operative steps up to navigate the dangerous battlegrounds and track her down. Along the way, he must outmaneuver ruthless mercenary factions, endure shifting front lines, and confront the trauma of his own violent past. Ultimately, his mission becomes a high-stakes fight for survival where every decision carries life-or-death consequences.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The sudden outbreak of war in Ukraine triggers widespread devastation, plunging the nation into chaos and scattering civilians across active battle zones. In the turbulent opening hours of the invasion, a dedicated foreign aid worker vanishes while attempting to assist in an evacuation effort. Word of her disappearance reaches a former Navy SEAL turned CIA operative, who recognizes the urgent window to save her before the region is completely sealed off. Unwilling to leave her to an uncertain fate, he quietly crosses into the shattered country alone, relying on decades of covert military training to navigate the lawless territory. As he tracks her trail through destroyed towns and unstable firing corridors, he encounters heavily armed mercenary units exploiting the collapse of order. The constantly shifting front lines force him to repeatedly alter his route, turning a simple extraction into a relentless game of survival. Along the journey, the horrors of the active conflict reawaken deeply buried trauma and personal regrets he thought he had left behind. With time running out and enemy forces closing in, he must draw on every ounce of skill and resolve to locate the aid worker and secure a way out of the war zone alive.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the sudden and violent onset of the war in Ukraine, this intense action thriller follows a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative who takes on an off-the-books rescue operation when an aid worker mysteriously disappears. Traversing a landscape fractured by bombardment, hostile military forces, and opportunist mercenaries, he must rely on his covert expertise to stay alive. Beyond the physical perils of the war zone, the journey forces him to confront his own haunting past, delivering a tense and harrowing examination of survival, sacrifice, and duty amidst modern warfare.
